About

Crafting refined digital experiences
with clarity, precision, and purpose.

I'm Avnik Gupta, a frontend web developer focused on creating modern, responsive, and visually engaging digital experiences. I combine clean code, thoughtful design implementation, and smooth interactions to build websites that are both polished and functional.

My core skills include HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, Bootstrap 5, jQuery, WordPress, responsive web design, Git, and GitHub. I focus on translating ideas and designs into well-structured, responsive websites using modern frontend practices.
